jobs.title: Real Estate Transaction Lead, Central
jobs.description: Mission Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear. In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives. Role Purpose We are looking for a driven, transaction-focused real estate professional to own deal execution across the Central region. You will be part of a lean, high-velocity expansion team reporting directly to the Director of Real Estate, US. This is not a support role. You will run site selection, lead LOI negotiations, manage broker relationships, and drive leases to execution across a growing portfolio of healthcare retail clinics in your markets. Neko is opening clinics at pace: the US plan moves from a handful of sites today to a 2028 cohort in the dozens and a portfolio in the hundreds by 2030. Most in-house real estate roles at this scale sit inside large corporate structures where deals move slowly and decisions need layers of approval. Here, your deals matter immediately, your judgment is trusted, and the decisions you make in year one will shape the portfolio for the next decade. The team is small and growing quickly, built around regional Transaction Leads covering the West, East, and Central United States, supported by national specialists in market analysis, deal support, and lease administration. Many of these seats are still being filled, so you will help set the standard rather than inherit one. jobs.description: 🏨 The Company Resilience Care, a leading player in remote medical monitoring and a partner in clinical research, is a French company founded in 2021 with a single mission: to provide better care. Our company offers remote monitoring solutions in oncology, gastroenterology, and psychiatry, based on the collection of ePROs combined with AI technologies. These solutions rely on a monitoring platform for healthcare professionals—enabling the early detection of side effects for continuous and proactive care—and a mobile app for patients, empowering them to measure and manage their symptoms using tailored resources. Our solutions optimize patient care, continuously enrich our understanding of patients throughout their healthcare journey, and accelerate clinical research through the collection, structuring, and in-depth analysis of real-world data. Today, our solutions are deployed in routine care for 35,000 patients across more than 200 healthcare facilities, as well as within the framework of around twenty academic and industrial clinical trials. Through this, we put data at the service of healthcare and therapeutic innovation, driven by the ambition to enable every patient to benefit from personalized medicine. 📝 Your Role In a few words You will coordinate the operations of Resilience-sponsored and investigator-initiated studies across several therapeutic areas. Your impact Help sites deliver studies effectively: follow protocols, maintain up-to-date documentation and ensure data quality. jobs.title: Home Based Primary Care Physician (MD/DO)
jobs.description: Practice medicine where it can matter most: in the home. Clover Health is looking for exceptional, mission-driven physicians to join our field-based In-Home Care team. In this role, you will care for Medicare Advantage members with complex medical, functional, and social needs — many of whom are older, medically fragile, and at high risk for avoidable complications. This is not transactional care. This is relationship-centered, outcomes-driven medicine. As a Field-Based Staff Physician, you will be accountable for the health outcomes of a defined panel of members. You will meet patients where they are, understand the realities of their home environment, identify risks early, and help coordinate the right care at the right time. You will have the autonomy to practice thoughtfully, the support of an interdisciplinary team, and the technology to act with greater insight and precision. We are seeking physicians who are highly accountable, clinically strong, operationally effective, and deeply committed to doing what is best for vulnerable seniors. Why this role matters Many of the patients we serve are navigating multiple chronic conditions, recent hospitalizations, fragmented care, limited resources, and the challenges that come with aging. For these members, the home is often where the most important clinical information lives. In this role, you will have the opportunity to see the full picture: the medications on the kitchen table, the caregiver dynamics, the fall risks, the barriers to follow-up, and the early warning signs that may never surface in a clinic visit. Your work will directly influence whether members recover safely, remain stable, avoid unnecessary hospitalizations, close care gaps, and feel supported by a care team that genuinely knows them.
